newsitem.title: USA: State Street up on takeover speculation.
newsitem.headline: State Street up on takeover speculation.

text.p: State Street Boston Corp soared six to 69 Friday as takeover speculation heated up following Thursday's news that Bank of New York Co Inc has accumulated a 4.99 percent stake and seeks approval to buy up to 9.9 percent.

But one analyst was skeptical that there would be a takeover. "I think it would be expensive for most of the likely buyers," said Ronald Mandle, analyst at Sanford C. Bernstein Co. He noted the share price to earnings multiple is in the upper teens, which is high for a bank stock.
Mandle also noted that the management of State Street Boston wants to remain independent.
In a news release Thursday night State Street said the board of directors believes the company's strategic goals can be best achieved if the company remains independent.
Mandle, who has a hold rating on the stock, said State Street Boston has a good long term track record and the management has done a good job.
Bank of New York was up 3/8 to 33-5/8 in early trading.
